changes.comment: Add capability-aware FileTree copy helpers (copyItemInto / copyContentsInto) that carry bytes verbatim where the destination store is byte-native and as verified round-trippable text where it is not, failing by default (onUnfaithfulFile: 'fail' | 'skip') on any file that would change; adds the byte-native child create capability (IMutableBinaryFileTreeDirectoryItem, isMutableBinaryDirectoryItem, DirectoryItem.canCreateChildFileBytes / createChildFileBytes) it is built on
